name: TEN Framework
description: Framework for real-time conversational voice agents, shipped with runnable example agents such as a voice assistant.
whatItDoes: Provides developers with ready examples of talking agents and the runtime to build their own low-latency voice or multimodal assistants. The examples can be started in a development container and tried in a browser.
howItWorks: Agents are graphs of extensions for speech recognition, language models and speech synthesis running on the TEN runtime. Real-time audio transport uses Agora. The sample agents live in the ai_agents directory and are installed and started with task commands inside a Docker container.
